title: Do not buy
text:
Do not buy. Edit.
This couch sucks. The frame is made up of 1x2 pieces of wood that have been stapled together. How do I know this? My 3 year old broke it. He sat down and the whole thing collapsed under him. I pulled the underfabric back to see if I could fix a screw or whatnot...but what I saw was horrific. The wood is so crooked. And broken. And stapled back together. No wonder it collapsed. I want my money back. Late delivery. Destroyed shipping box. After less than 2 months of occasional use by a 3 year old....its broken. So disappointed.
*end edit

The biggest problem with this item was the means of delivery. The delivery team did not take very good care of the box. Box was destroyed upon arrival. Parts of the metal assembly were bent which made assembly virtually impossible. Eventually, we got it together. The item is very uncomfortable. The arms are not sturdy at all. I blame most of that on the the handling during shipping.

product_metadata.title: Lexicon Knoxville Convertible Studio Sofa Bed, Dove
features: Dove microfiber upholstery with tufting accent
Ships in one (1) box and requires assembly
description: With versatility of function, the Lexicon Knoxville collection presents as a unique seating option for your household. The pull-out bed and click-mechanism seat back of this convertible studio sofa engage to create a platform for sleeping or relaxing. Offered in a dove microfiber fabric cover for decorative neutrality, the classic design is further enhanced with the tufted fronts of the seat, back and pop-up trundle.

details.Included Components: Legs, Sofa seat, Screwdriver, Screws, Arms
details.Special Feature: Pull-out bed, Click Clack Seat Back
